auditCriteria.text: Workstation OS: Windows 10/11 64-bit clean install (No piracy/adware)
RAM & CPU: Minimum 4GB RAM + Intel i3/i5 multi-core processor
Display: Minimum 15-inch monitor (1024x768 or higher native resolution)
Physical Spacing: 4 feet (1.2m) separation OR rigid 18-inch privacy partitions
Internet Connection: Dedicated commercial static IP line (10+ Mbps wired Ethernet)
Zero-Latency Power: Commercial Online UPS with battery bank (min 30 min runtime)
Emergency Power: Automatic Diesel Generator (DG) synchronization
CCTV Surveillance: High-res cameras covering every candidate screen with zero blind spots
Proctor Command: Dedicated administrator PC overlooking candidate room
Security & Lockers: Lockable candidate storage & strict no-cellphone check-in gate
